text.en:
29th. DECEMBER. 2018 No. S 68

SYARIAH PENAL CODE ORDER, 2013 (S 6912013) Notification of commencement In furtherance to the notification of commencement published as No. S 1712014 in Part I1 of the Government Gazette dated 1st May 2014, in exercise of the power conferred by section 1.(1] and (2) of the Syariah Penal Code Order, 2013, the Minister of Religious Affairs, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 27th Rejab 1440 Hijriah corresponding to 3rd April 2019 as the date of commencement for the provisions of that Order as set out in the Schedule hereto -

SCHEDULE

PROVISIONS OF SYARIAH PENAL CODE ORDER, 2013

PART IV - Chapter I (excluding section 94); Chapter 11; Sections 186 to 188; Section 206; Sections 221 to 227;

PART V - Section 254 (with respect to sections 172, 194 and 195 of the Religious Council and Kadis Courts Act (Chapter 77)). Dated this 21st. day of Rabiulakhir, 1440 Hijriah corresponding to the 29th. day of December, 2018.

PEHIN UDANA KHATIB DATO PADUKA SERI SETIA USTAZ

HAJI AWANG BADARUDDIN BIN PENGARAH

DATO PADUKA HAJI AWANG OTHMAN Minister of Religious Affairs.
